# SHINY APP (Antony and Bryan)

```{r, eval=F, echo=T}
#install.packages(c("shiny", "shinythemes", "ggplot2", "ggplot", "ggmap", "dplyr", "readr"))
library(shiny)
library(shinythemes)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggmap)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(shinydashboard)
# Load the data
data <- read_csv("usa_data.csv")
map_data <- read_csv("usa_map.csv")

# Define UI
ui <- dashboardPage(
  
  dashboardHeader(title = "U.S. Alcohol Related Deaths", titleWidth = 400),
  
  dashboardSidebar(
    width = 300,
    sidebarMenu(
      selectInput("state", "Select State", choices = c("All", unique(data$State))),
      selectInput("effect_duration", "Select Effect Duration", choices = c("All", unique(data$Effect_Duration))),
      selectInput("effect_category", "Select Effect Category", choices = c("All", unique(data$Effect_Category))),
      selectInput("effect", "Select Effect", choices = c("All", unique(data$Effect)))
    ),
  hr(),
  helpText("Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Alcohol Related Disease Impact (ARDI) application, 2024. Available at www.cdc.gov/ARDI.")),
    
    dashboardBody(
    tags$style(HTML("
  .main-sidebar, .main-sidebar .sidebar {
    background-color: #F8F9FA !important;
  }
  .sidebar-menu a {
    color: black !important;
    font-weight: bold;
  }
  .sidebar-menu a:hover {
    background-color: #DCDCDC !important;
  }

  /* Fix select input text & alignment */
  .shiny-input-container {
    color: black !important;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: bold;
  }
  .selectize-input, .selectize-dropdown {
    background-color: white !important;
    color: black !important;
  }
  .form-control {
    background-color: white !important;
    color: black !important;
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  .sidebar-menu {
    padding-left: 10px;
  }
  .selectize-input, .shiny-input-container {
    width: 100% !important; 
    text-align: left !important; 
"))
,
  fluidRow(
   box(column(6, plotOutput("histogram"))), 
    box(column(6, plotOutput("boxplot")))
  ),
  fluidRow(
    box(column(12, plotOutput("bubbleplot")))
  )
)
)

# Define server logic
server <- function(input, output,session) {
  
  session$onSessionEnded(stopApp)
  
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    df <- data
    
    if(input$state != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(State == input$state)
    }
    if(input$effect_duration != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(Effect_Duration == input$effect_duration)
    }
    if(input$effect_category != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(Effect_Category == input$effect_category)
    }
    if(input$effect != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(Effect == input$effect)
    }
    
    df
  })

 
  output$histogram <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(filtered_data(), aes(x = factor(Age), y = Deaths)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
      labs(title = "Deaths by Age Group",
           x = "Age Group",
           y = "Number of Deaths") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))})
    
    output$boxplot <- renderPlot({
      ggplot(filtered_data(), aes(x = Age, y = Deaths)) +
        geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue") +
        labs(title = "Deaths by Age Group",
           x = "Age Group",
           y = "Number of Deaths (log10)") +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + 
        scale_y_log10()})
    
    output$bubbleplot <- renderPlot({
      ggplot(data = filtered_data(),aes(x = Age, y = Deaths, size = Effect_Duration, color = Effect_Duration)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
        scale_size_manual(values = c("Chronic" = 4, "Acute" = 2)) +
        labs(title = "Alcohol-Related Deaths by Age (Bubble Chart)",
             x = "Age Group",
             y = "Number of Deaths",
             size = "Effect Duration") +
        theme_minimal()+
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust=1))+
        theme(plot.title=element_text(size=rel(1.5),hjust=0.5))})
}

# Run the app
shinyApp(ui, server)

library(rsconnect)
deployApp()

```
